purpose: Independent verification of the already-trained reference-input head R; not an additional oracle arm.
scope: All 5 archived CBIS-DDSM units and all 25 archived Derm7pt units.
reference_input: Archived reference annotations; diagnostic training restricted to each outer training set T.
selection: Refit balanced L2 logistic regression for each C in [0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100] on each of four archived inner training sets; select mean class-equal validation NLL; first grid value on exact ties.
final_fit: Fresh fit on gold[T],y[T]; evaluate gold[E] for R and val for S. No selection uses E.
export: Aggregate discrepancies and selected regularization values only; no patient identifiers, predictions, or coefficients.
